headline: Barnes' late layup ends Toronto's skid
dek: Scottie Barnes scored 29, including the go-ahead layup with 14.3 seconds left, and Toronto ended a six-game skid.
three: 14 of 21 from the floor, then the go-ahead layup with 14.3 left.
Raptors up 6 at the half, held on after Detroit took the lead late
Five Raptors scored in double figures.
Won it with ball movement and on the glass
Assists 29–20; rebounds 40–33. Toronto shot 42 of 77 from the floor.
